full_page.content:
1927, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 38 Cont.
July 19th Same Mrs. Clairmont here To-day to get blessing and re-enrolled this evening - not at all out of danger - Husband already twice to Holy Communion.
July 27th To-day able for some days to retain nourishment - Friday last vomited a very remarkable creature - something "frog-like."
Aug. 1st Mary Garrity 20, of 5774 - 15th St. Enrolled several times last year annually and received positive favors, including cure of kid- ney consumption. Last evening was reported now as very sick with some kind of Brain-pressure. No better To-day, she is enrolled perpetually - doctors preparing to open scull tomorrow
Aug. 8th Mrs. Mary Knapp. 58 of 3657 Concord enrolled as against diabetes and threatened blood-poison for one year ( Aug 4th) goes to Ford Hospital same day. Next morning inflamation was entirely gone from the leg. The one toe remaining somewhat swollen Doctors insist on opening said toe and at once infection starts again. To-day fear - in that the leg be lost. She is enrolled perpet- ually this a.m.
Aug. 26 Reported that next A.M. doctors again surprised when last en- rolled i e Aug 9th Another operation is proposed to-morrow & she is enrolled 3rd time to-night.
Page 39
Sept. 9th Baby Saved. Francis Amelia Girard, 2 in October, of 592 Notre Dame Ave, Grous Pt. was enrolled last Friday, just a week ago. The doctor claimed she had but three days to live: "Asadosis stomach". they claimed was the trouble - with liver and kidney - trouble and heart in bad condition, and head swolen till her eyes could not open. This evening she is brought to the Monastery with the rest of the family to thank God for her remarkable recovery. Deo Gr. Died (later entry)
Sept. 13th Edward Collins 4. of 641 St. Jean enrolled perpetually three months ago for cripled leg and once or twice since, is to have operation To-day on knee
18 Mrs. Anna Charboneau 22 of 14142 Detroit Manor, about to have oper- ation on stomach after 4 years sickness is enrolled July 4th 1926 next day opened door for doctor who came to tell her the operation would be next day. Instead of operation she and husband started on a 500 mile trip by 24 hours and was in perfect health - and is so ever since.
